correctness_authority: Both initial suffix retries and both timed cache hits match all 512 original GB10 tokens and the token-bound first logit within 0.125. Warm hits also match every actual stream callback. Complete owner prompt and first token/logit are independently GB10-anchored.
scope: Only the actual 16384-token owner plus 1024-token suffix and 512-token continuation are measured. The owner seed emits one token; the oracle owner continuation of 32 tokens is not claimed. Prefix restoration and changed-prefix rejection pass; saved checkpoints, other contexts, packages, HTTP and soak remain separate.
decision: Retain the default-off route for continued product work; assess the exact all-cell option from these single-run observations without declaring retained performance.
